effects.name: Iron Oath
effects.targetSignal: 4 frontliners or double-frontline teams should stop collapsing first.
effects.risk: If all teams benefit, it is just a global stat bump. Watch backline caster teams.

effects.name: Arcane Tide
effects.targetSignal: Mage/warlock/alchemist teams should win by skill bursts, not by basic attacks.
effects.risk: Skill haste can become a universal answer if physical carries also rely on skills too much.

effects.name: Blood Moon
effects.targetSignal: Berserker teams should show late fight flips instead of only early stat checks.
effects.risk: May hide berserker weakness by adding too much sustain. Compare no-priest teams.

effects.name: Hunter Fog
effects.targetSignal: Ranger/assassin teams should punish fragile backlines but not delete every frontline team.
effects.risk: Single-target burst can become unreadable. Check double-frontline bucket.

effects.name: Ember Air
effects.targetSignal: Burn/poison teams should get stronger across longer fights.
effects.risk: If DOT is too slow, the effect reads weak even when math is correct.

effects.name: Shield Echo
effects.targetSignal: Knight/priest/bard shells should survive bursts and win by second rotation.
effects.risk: If it only makes fights longer, it teaches nothing. Watch damage contribution.

effects.name: Tempo Drum
effects.targetSignal: Fast attackers should gain, pure casters should not receive the same answer.
effects.risk: Could over-buff already good physical shells. Compare against Iron Oath teams.

effects.name: Frost Clock
effects.targetSignal: Ranger/mage/bard/alchemist teams should win by delaying enemy rotations.
effects.risk: Control is less explicit than damage. The lab should show expected winners clearly.

effects.name: Crown Relay
effects.targetSignal: Knight/priest/bard/warlock shells should make one carry's damage and survival jump, not buff every random team.
effects.risk: If the support package becomes universal, it can turn into a generic all-team stat field. Watch non-support teams.

effects.name: Many-Target Hall
effects.targetSignal: Warrior/mage/alchemist/ranger teams should lower several enemy HP bars together instead of only deleting one unit.
effects.risk: Can blur into DOT or caster fields if mage/alchemist dominate. Watch whether warrior/ranger mixed teams also benefit.

effects.name: Duelist Ring
effects.targetSignal: Warrior/assassin teams should win by quickly removing one key unit, not by outlasting everything.
effects.risk: If double-assassin deletes every team, this becomes a burst stat check instead of a duel lesson.

effects.name: Backline Beacon
effects.targetSignal: Ranger/mage/bard backlines should show stable ranged pressure behind one or two bodies.
effects.risk: Too broad if every standard balanced team benefits equally from having one ranged unit.

effects.name: Plague Workshop
effects.targetSignal: Alchemist/warlock teams should feel like they are building an engine over time.
effects.risk: May overlap Ember Air. It should be the alchemist/warlock engine version, not generic burn/poison.

effects.name: Banner March
effects.targetSignal: Warrior/knight/bard teams should feel safer and more consistent, not explosively stronger.
effects.risk: If too strong, it becomes the boring safe answer for every dungeon.

effects.name: Consecrated Well
effects.targetSignal: Priest/knight/bard teams should visibly recover between enemy waves of pressure.
effects.risk: Can be boring if it only prevents death without creating a second-rotation payoff.

effects.name: Witching Hour
effects.targetSignal: Mage/warlock/bard teams should spike harder on repeated skill rotations.
effects.risk: Can duplicate Arcane Tide unless warlock/bard mixed teams are the clearest winners.

effects.name: Thorn Maze
effects.targetSignal: Ranger/alchemist/bard teams should win by delaying contact and stretching the fight.
effects.risk: Control payoff can be invisible without battle signals; keep it numerically distinct from Frost Clock.

effects.name: Red Anvil
effects.targetSignal: Berserker/warrior/priest teams should survive long enough for melee pressure to matter.
effects.risk: May overlap Blood Moon; it should be priest-supported brawl, not pure low-health comeback.

effects.name: Spellblade Corridor
effects.targetSignal: Warrior/mage/assassin mixes should show value from both physical and magical pressure.
effects.risk: If hybrid becomes simply better than focused damage, it hurts build identity.

effects.name: Breaker's Yard
effects.targetSignal: Warrior/alchemist/assassin teams should be better into shield or stall shells without becoming universal.
effects.risk: Without true shield-damage hooks this is only an approximation; later should become an anti-shield rule.
